blocks.text: The first parcel is $40.60. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Canvas bib is not ticked. Cloth braid audio lead, 1 m is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
The shop desk answers during open hours.
The later bill is fifty six dollars and seventy cents every thirty days.
